# Generated files, spine_sky_builder_w2

The master is the whole sky of the ridge with nothing in it but sky; the six windows are the same picture enlarged piece by piece. `assets-src/spine/sky/join.cjs` joins them into `public/assets/spine/mat/skypano.jpg` (see `assets-src/spine/sky/RECIPE.md`). Never a plate: the picture is read by bearing and height, flows along its own field, and scud crosses before it.
